input: After switching to a new panel revision (BOE vs-120-rev03), the display fails to initialize. dmesg shows: 'panel-simple: failed to send DCS command 0x29 (set_display_on), err=-110' followed by 'dsi_host: command mode timeout waiting for BTA'. The old panel (rev02) worked with the same init sequence. Comparing datasheets, rev03 requires an extra 20ms delay after exit_sleep_mode (DCS 0x11) before accepting further commands, and the VCOM voltage setting (DCS 0xC5) parameter changed from 2 bytes to 3 bytes. Our panel driver hardcodes the init sequence in panel_init_cmds[]. How do we properly handle panel revision differences in the DCS init sequence, and is there a standard way to detect panel revision at runtime via MIPI DCS read commands?
